name: Sátorhely (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red, green and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sátorhely: a quartered shield of yellow, green and red with a sabre, ears of grain, a tent and a bunch of grapes, with red mantling and a scroll inscribed SÁTORHELY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
